relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 stabilizing the downregulation of SOCS1 by targeting m6A methylation modifications at positions 151, 164, and 966

relationships.subject: SOCS1
relationships.evidence_quote: the depletion of endogenous SOCS1 promoted NP progression by inducing the toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) signaling pathway

relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: Exogenous supplementation of METTL3 improved NP-related neuroinflammation and behavioral dysfunctions, but these effects could be reversed by the absence of SOCS1.

key_findings: METTL3 and m6A levels are downregulated in SNL neuropathic pain, with increased IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α.
METTL3 m6A-modifies SOCS1; SOCS1 loss activates TLR4 signaling.
